name: CRM, LMS, HRMS & Billing
headline: Run customers, people, learning and money from one system.
intro: Business management platforms for customer relationships, training, HR operations and invoicing, built to fit your workflow instead of forcing you into someone else's.

overview.what: We build and implement four families of management systems: CRM for sales and customer relationships, LMS for training and courses, HRMS for employee lifecycle and payroll, and billing for invoices, subscriptions and collections.
overview.why: Growth multiplies the number of people, customers and transactions to track. Without a system of record, information lives in spreadsheets and inboxes, follow-ups are missed and managers lack reliable numbers.
problems: Leads and customer history scattered across chats, sheets and personal notes
Training that is hard to schedule, track or prove for compliance
Attendance, leave and payroll prepared by hand every month
Invoices created late, payments chased manually and revenue hard to forecast
overview.approach: We model your actual workflows and approval chains, configure or build the right modules, migrate your existing data and integrate the systems so information flows from lead to invoice to payroll.

deliver.d: Lead capture, pipeline stages, contacts, follow-up reminders, quotations and sales reporting.
Course authoring, enrolment, assessments, progress tracking and certificates.
Employee records, attendance, leave, onboarding, payroll inputs and document management.
Quotes, tax-compliant invoices, subscriptions, payment links and receivables tracking.
Views tailored to owners, managers, staff, learners and customers.
Import from existing sheets and tools and connect to accounting, email and messaging.

capabilities.d: Assignment rules, reminders and stage-based tasks keep every lead moving.
Video, documents and quizzes, learning paths, batches and attendance for online or classroom training.
Shifts, biometric or mobile check-in, leave policies and approval chains.
Salary structures, deductions and statutory inputs prepared and exported accurately.
Tax calculations, invoice numbering, credit notes and payment reconciliation.
Operational and management reports with a record of who changed what and when.

process.d: We document how leads, learners, staff and invoices move today and where time is lost.
We recommend building custom or configuring an established platform based on fit and cost.
Modules, roles, forms, approvals and reports are set up around your workflow.
Existing records are cleaned, mapped and imported with reconciliation checks.
Staged adoption with role-based training and clear documentation.
Help-desk support and changes as your processes mature.

benefits.d: Reminders and pipelines ensure each lead, learner and invoice is followed up.
Automation reduces manual HR, training and billing paperwork.
Timely invoices and payment links shorten collection cycles.
Management reports come from one consistent source.
Workflows are configured to your process instead of a rigid template.

usecases.d: An LMS and billing system manage batches, fees, attendance and certificates.
CRM tracks enquiries to proposals, then converts them into recurring invoices.
HRMS automates onboarding, attendance and leave across locations.
Billing handles plans, renewals, reminders and payment reconciliation.

cta.h: Replace scattered spreadsheets with one system that fits.
cta.p: Tell us which processes feel heaviest today. We will suggest the right combination of modules and a sensible rollout order.
